description: This file contains functions for fusing modules in a PyTorch model, specifically tailored for quantization workflows. It provides utilities for batching fuse operations like conv + bn, conv + relu, and others, along with helper functions to manipulate module hierarchies and perform fusion both in training and quantization-aware training (QAT) contexts.

methods.name: _get_module(model, submodule_key)
methods.description: Retrieves a nested submodule from a model given a dot-separated key.

methods.name: _set_module(model, submodule_key, module)
methods.description: Sets a nested submodule in a model given a dot-separated key.

methods.name: fuse_known_modules(mod_list, is_qat, additional_fuser_method_mapping=None)
methods.description: Returns a list of modules fused according to known fusion patterns for quantization.

methods.name: _fuse_modules_helper( model, modules_to_fuse, is_qat, fuser_func=fuse_known_modules, fuse_custom_config_dict=None, )
methods.description: Helper to fuse specified modules within a model, using provided fusion function.

methods.name: _fuse_modules( model, modules_to_fuse, is_qat, inplace=False, fuser_func=fuse_known_modules, fuse_custom_config_dict=None, )
methods.description: Fuses modules based on list of module names or list of module name lists, creating a fused model.

methods.name: fuse_modules( model, modules_to_fuse, inplace=False, fuser_func=fuse_known_modules, fuse_custom_config_dict=None, )
methods.description: Public API to fuse given modules in a model, adapting for different fusion patterns, possibly inplace.

methods.name: fuse_modules_qat( model, modules_to_fuse, inplace=False, fuser_func=fuse_known_modules, fuse_custom_config_dict=None, )
methods.description: QAT-specific version of fuse_modules for quantization-aware training workflows.

ctags.name: _fuse_modules
ctags.signature: ( model, modules_to_fuse, is_qat, inplace=False, fuser_func=fuse_known_modules, fuse_custom_config_dict=None, )
